name: Memory of the Oblivious
source:
"A man wakes up in a hospital and receives two mysterious visitors.
What do they want with him, and what does he mean to them...?"

[warning: possible despair]

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26912]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
“一个男人在医院醒来，迎来了两名神秘访客。
他们想从他这里得到什么？他对他们来说又意味着什么……？”

[警告：可能引发绝望]
